# Data Source: tfe_registry_gpg_key

Gets information about a private registry GPG key.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeRegistryGpgKey.DataTfeRegistryGpgKey(this, "example", new DataTfeRegistryGpgKeyConfig {
            Id = "13DFECCA3B58CE4A",
            Organization = "my-org-name"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Id` (String) ID of the GPG key.

### Optional

- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `AsciiArmor` (String) ASCII-armored representation of the GPG key.
- `CreatedAt` (String) The time when the GPG key was created.
- `UpdatedAt` (String) The time when the GPG key was last updated.
